name: Feature request
about: Propose a bounded, safe improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement

## Outcome

Describe the user-visible result and who needs it.

## Current limitation

Describe the current behavior using a tagged release or exact commit.

## Proposed behavior

Include platform, data, migration, compatibility, and rollback effects.

## Safety, privacy, and provider impact

State whether this touches credentials, precise telemetry, vehicle commands,
network exposure, third-party APIs, retention, or legal notices.

## Alternatives

List existing tools or simpler approaches already considered.

Do not include credentials, VINs, coordinates, production data, or undisclosed
security details.
